thread:
maria: Heads-up — after the role-split backfill ran we’re seeing users with only the VIEWER mapping showing the Edit button in project settings. Repro quickly: login as a viewer -> /projects/infra/settings -> Edit visible. Anyone else seeing this?

jonah: I can repro on staging. looks like the UI is using cached role aliases instead of server ACL check. :eyes:

kevin: This smells like a race during the backfill where the old `editor` alias was temporarily present in role_bindings while the new scoped roles were being written.

maria: KMS/audit shows the backfill job wrote role mappings at 2024-07-03T13:02:31Z. snippet from backfill log: ```
2024-07-03T13:02:31Z INFO backfill job=rbac-split user=system role_alias=editor -> [project-editor, org-editor] status=ok commit=sha@4f3a
2024-07-03T13:02:31Z INFO cache.invalidate key=role_alias:editor result=success
2024-07-03T13:02:31Z WARN race detected stale_bindings=12
```

amy: UX: we shouldn't rely on client-only gating. server must be the source of truth. UI should only render edit control when API returns can_edit=true. This prevents visual exposure.

kevin: I pushed a hotfix PR that forces an API permission check before rendering edit/button: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/8423 (patch: server-check -> render). will open prod rollout.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: console-hotfix/8423 -> prod at 2024-07-03T13:15:00Z by kevin.

maria: Immediate mitigation checklist: 1) block client affordance (kevin PR) 2) pause backfill job 3) identify affected users + revoke transient grants 4) add audit event for ui_render_exposed -> include user_id, roles_snapshot, request_id.

jonah: Query to find affected principals (quick):
```sql
SELECT user_id, project_id, role_alias, migrated_at
FROM role_bindings
WHERE role_alias = 'editor' AND migrated_at BETWEEN '2024-07-03 12:50:00' AND '2024-07-03 13:10:00';
```
I'll run and drop results to #incidents.

ops-julia: Pausing backfill now (job id=rbac-backfill-2024-07-03). paused at 2024-07-03T13:20:12Z. snapshotting DB before rollback.

kevin: For short term, adding a deny rule in the edge proxy for the settings route until we confirm DB-surface is clean. snippet: ```yaml
- match: "/api/projects/*/settings"
  require: ["server:check:can_edit_project"]
  default: deny
```
Applying in 5m.

maria: Also confirm audit logs are persisted and encrypted by KMS. We need to export the role snapshots for each affected event. security-bot, can you capture KMS envelope ids?

security-bot: Audit export started INC-2024-284. Export id=audit-export-87. KMS-envelope-ids attached.

jonah: I'm pulling full list + recent access events between 13:00-13:30 UTC and will correlate with session IDs. Will post sanitized CSV.

kevin: Plan: rollback the backfill, re-run with stricter atomic swap (apply-new-roles -> update-bindings in single transaction) and add a cache-flush barrier. I'll open an RFC and schedule the rerun after we validate on staging.

maria: Assigning action owners: jonah -> forensic & affected-users list; kevin -> rollback + backfill fix; ops-julia -> job control + DB snapshots; amy -> check console UX surface; i'll own postmortem.

jonah: Confirmed. I'll also run a one-off query to look for stale role_alias entries and produce a cleanup script.

kevin: Monitoring logs now. initial telemetry shows ~1.2k render-exposed events between 13:02 and 13:18. Will throttle and watch for any repeats. :thumbsup:

maria: After we stabilize, we need to add an automated test in infra-e2e: emulate role-split backfill and assert server denies UI render for users without write grants.

ops-julia: DB snapshot saved -> s3://backups/rbac-snap-2024-07-03-1320 (sha=abc123). Rolling back backfill now. ETA ~10m.

deploy-bot: console-hotfix/8423 deployed to prod (success).

kevin: Prod hotfix confirmed — edit button hidden for repro user on prod. continuing to monitor.

maria: Thanks everyone. We'll treat this as Sev3 (data exposure surface), run postmortem tomorrow 09:30 PT. jonah, please post CSV and affected-user count to #incidents when ready.

security-bot: Incident INC-2024-284 created and assigned to eng-security.

jonah: CSV posted to #incidents. affected_count=1210. starting targeted emails to org owners for the projects in the list.

maria: Closing thread here, will kick off postmortem doc. If anyone sees further anomalies, ping me directly.

kevin: Will follow up with the backfill RFC and add the transaction barrier and cache-invalidate hook.

ops-julia: All mitigations applied. leaving job paused.

maria: closing. :white_check_mark:
